register: # SOURCE: ABB/FIMER 'Modbus RTU registers map for TRIO - Version GB00, TRIO-5.8(8.5)-TL-OUTD (rev 0.2, 2015)' (vendor document). ABB's tables give 1-based Modbus Data Addresses and state that the PDU address on the wire is one less, so every CSV register here is the table address minus 1 (each note shows the table address).

# FUNCTION CODES: measurements are input registers (FC04). The holding map (FC03 read, FC06/FC16 write; broadcast writes are supported) has the heartbeat and grid measures plus ABB's documented controls, marked RW with ABB's range for write validation. Whether anything can actually be written is decided by the app's gates (transport write_enabled and the per-register W toggle in the web UI). Power management has two independent blocks: block 1 (holding 189-226, older) and block 2 (holding 500-515, plant controller); configure 500-505 before sending a block-2 set point.

documented_name: Block 1 Power Ramping Interval (Permanent and Dynamic)
note: table 190; ABB read/write control. Power ramping interval, 0-250 (4 s step); default 15.
table 191; ABB read/write control. Countdown used for dynamic active/reactive commands.
table 198; ABB read/write control. Smooth configuration: low byte 128 = trip-time mode, 0 = fixed slope; high byte bit 0: 0 = 4 s step, 1 = 1 s step. Default 0.

documented_name: Block 1 Dynamic Power Factor Set Point
note: table 200; ABB read/write control. ABB range -1.0..1.0 (negative = over-excited, positive = under-excited). Dynamic: reverts to the default when the timeout register expires. IEEE-754 float, word-swapped (low register first).

documented_name: Block 1 Permanent Power Factor Set Point
note: table 202; ABB read/write control. ABB range -1.0..1.0 (negative = over-excited, positive = under-excited). Permanent: stored in the inverter's memory; ABB warns that writing permanent set points continuously can damage that memory, so use dynamic set points for regulation. IEEE-754 float, word-swapped (low register first).
table 205; ABB read/write control. Write 1 to reset PF to 1; the register then returns to 0.

documented_name: Block 1 Dynamic Active Power Set Point
